events.headline: Link to watch Saints Soccer at OCAA Final 4
events.summary: The St. Clair women's soccer team is at Centennial College this weekend for the OCAA Final 4 tournament and open against the host and East Division champs.

events.headline: Lancers Cross Country hosting provincials
events.summary: The Windsor Lancers are hosting the OUA Championships Saturday at Malden Park. The men are first on the course at 11am while the women begin at noon.

events.headline: 'Seven teams can win this thing': Lancers football open playoffs at home
events.summary: For the second straight week, the Windsor Lancers take on the Guelph Gryphons this time at Alumni Field Saturday afternoon at 1pm. Windsor won last week’s regular season finale 27-23 in Guelph.
